title: Research Growth Became A Global Filing Race
hook: More researchers created a publishing giant—and a worldwide patent rush.
closing: Research scale now shapes who publishes breakthroughs and who races to protect them.
question: Who wins the research race?

segments.say: Researchers reached 1,652 per million people. A larger workforce gave scientific output room to accelerate.
China published 932,712 scientific articles. That scale made one country the center of the research race.
Nonresident patent applications reached 1,022,400. Research output now crosses borders before becoming protected technology.
